title: Prescriptions Schedule of Repeat Reductions on Travel Refills
content:
A Kestrel Prescriptions record that has already received travel refills carries the vacation override repeat reduction on the next one.

## Schedule

The vacation override repeat reduction counts the earlier vacation override refills on the prescription in the last 12 months:

| Earlier vacation override refills in the last 12 months | Days taken off |
|---|---|
| two or more | 30 |
| exactly one | 15 |
| none | nothing |

The days taken off are deducted from the vacation override days supply, and the days supply after its deductions is never below zero.

## Readings (hypothetical ledgers)

- One travel refill 5 months ago: 15 days are taken off.
- Travel refills 3 and 9 months ago: 30 days are taken off.
- A travel refill 13 months ago and none since: none in the last 12 months, so nothing is taken off.
- Refills with the fill reason routine, lost or stolen replacement or dosage change are not vacation override refills and are not counted.
